create_adversarial_car_racing_env: create a CarRacingBezierAdversarial environment with custom control points and sparse rewards
step_adversary_agent: step the adversary agent to place a new control point on the track sketch
reset_to_level: reset the adversarial car racing environment to a specific pre-defined level configuration
reset_agent_status: reset the car agent status and recreate the track from adversary control points
reset_random_track: reset the adversarial environment with a randomized track and optional fixed seed
